projects.title: Ysyx Workbench
bullets: Organized a large C/C++ hardware workbench spanning thousands of files into buildable Makefile targets, packaging the toolchain with Docker for consistent runs.
Kept a running build log after an untracked change forced a full day's rebuild, using it to trace which modules needed rebuilding across 200 commits.

projects.title: Solar
bullets: Wrote an automated pytest suite for a Python utility project, configuring test options and code formatting with black to keep contributions consistent.

leadership.title: Build Coordinator
bullets: Noticed teammates on a shared embedded project repeatedly duplicating setup steps and started a shared checklist covering environment, build flags, and test commands.
Tracked open tasks across three student teams preparing for a systems showcase, flagging blocked items during weekly check-ins so handoffs did not stall.
